bands.label: Open US-Iran exchange
bands.summary: US launches strikes on Iran, an American Apache helicopter is downed near Hormuz, Iran vows it will not hesitate to defend itself and Israeli strikes kill dozens in south Lebanon as Trump threatens further attacks.

bands.label: Regional war widens
bands.summary: Israel-Hezbollah fighting escalates into open war on the Lebanon front, direct Iran-Israel exchanges break the proxy ceiling and the US is drawn from backstop into active strikes.

bands.label: Gaza war opens northern front
bands.summary: Hamas's Oct 7 attack triggers the Gaza war and Hezbollah opens a cross-border front in solidarity, pulling Lebanon, Iran-backed groups and US forces in the region into a widening confrontation.

bands.label: Post-2006 deterrence
bands.summary: After the 2006 Israel-Hezbollah war and Lebanon blockade, an uneasy deterrence holds along the Blue Line while Hezbollah's arsenal grows, Iran's nuclear file hardens and US-Iran sanctions cycles deepen.

bands.label: Rupture and proxies
bands.summary: The Iranian revolution and embassy crisis rupture US-Iran ties, Israel's 1982 invasion of Lebanon and the rise of Hezbollah set the proxy architecture, and Iraq wars cement US military presence across the Gulf.

frames.label: Oct 2023
frames.note: Story opens with the Oct 7 Hamas attack and Hezbollah's cross-border barrages a day later. Under this frame, today's US strikes on Iran and Israeli operations in south Lebanon read as the spreading edge of a single war that began in late 2023. This is the frame US and Israeli officials and most Western broadcasters open with.

frames.label: 2006 Lebanon war
frames.note: Story opens with the 2006 Israel-Hezbollah war and the blockade and reconstruction years that followed. Under this frame, current Israeli strikes on Tyre, Sidon and south Lebanon read as the resumption of an unfinished Lebanon conflict, not a Gaza spillover. This is the frame Lebanese papers, Al Jazeera and Arab regional outlets open with.

frames.label: 1979 revolution
frames.note: Story opens with the 1979 Iranian revolution, the US embassy crisis and the rupture of US-Iran relations. Under this frame, the current US strikes and Iranian retaliation read as the latest chapter of a 47-year US-Iran confrontation that has run through Lebanon, Iraq and the Gulf. This is the frame Tehran, TASS and many non-aligned analysts open with.
